title: JSON schema for WordPress dashboard widget static metadata

content.description: Contextual help note for compact surfaces. Translatable. May carry `<em>`/`<strong>`; links belong in `links`.

links.description: Links contextual to the help note.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for this file. Used by IDEs and validation tooling.

name.description: Stable widget type identifier, structured as `<widget-namespace>/<widget-name>`. Both segments are lowercase, kebab-case.

title.description: Human-readable title that names the widget type. Translatable via `textdomain`.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the widget type does. Translatable via `textdomain`.

help.description: Contextual help note for compact surfaces such as tooltips beside the widget title. Translatable via `textdomain`.

category.description: Grouping category. Core provides `dashboard`; plugins and themes may register custom categories.

presentation.description: Authoring intent about how the widget asks to sit in the host's frame. Not a user-editable attribute. When absent, hosts treat the widget as `framed`.

keywords.description: Alternative terms used to match the widget type when searching. Translatable via `textdomain`.

textdomain.description: Gettext text domain for translating `title`, `description`, `help`, and `keywords`.
